notes: Owner-scoped brownfield exceptions for files exceeding readability budgets. Every entry names an owner, a genuine justification, and a reopen trigger that must fire before the exception is reconsidered. Stale entries (file no longer over budget) and unknown paths are rejected by scripts/file-budget-audit.mjs with a non-zero exit in both warn-only and fail modes — remove entries when their files are split below budget.

exceptions.reason: Matrix-campaign planning/runner orchestration core: planner, runner contract, checkpoint, controller packets, and operator lanes share one sealed state machine; mechanical extraction would slice the state machine without behavior characterization coverage for runner/checkpoint seams.
exceptions.reopen_trigger: Characterization suite for matrix runner/checkpoint transitions lands, or the file grows past 2600 LOC, or the next owner-approved refactor touches this planner.

exceptions.reason: Level-3 planning pipeline (preflight, policy gates, slice sequencing, lifecycle plans) is one ordered decision sequence; slicing phases before the sequence has per-phase characterization risks reordering gated decisions.
exceptions.reopen_trigger: Per-phase characterization tests land, or the file grows past 2000 LOC, or level-3 planning semantics change next.

exceptions.reason: Report formatting catalog (shared section renderers plus format-version invariants) is byte-anchored by golden snapshots; a format-module split must land together with golden regeneration to stay behavior-preserving.
exceptions.reopen_trigger: Next report-format version bump that regenerates goldens, or the file grows past 1900 LOC.
